notes: Scope: original weekend series through 2000-12-02, unified Wed/Sat series from 2000-12-06; earlier Sunday dates retained as supplied by the official CSV.
Official CSV columns 2:8 contain the six main numbers; column 10 is Superzahl, not Zusatzzahl. Blank Superzahl maps to -1.
Current official CSV is the canonical reference. The older 2021 Excel ZIP disagrees on dates for two 1966 holiday draws and two July 2014/2015 draws; CSV dates take precedence.
Original files and previous evaluation summaries were preserved in results/archive_audit before repair.
loader_note: The old loader skipped the first 2021 record because its header was missing. There are 55 added records and one recovered by fixing parsing.

notes: Main numbers only; Brier and log loss score marginal inclusion probabilities, not jackpot probabilities.

Strength and method selection use tuning only. Holdout history updates after each observed draw.
Intervals are paired circular block bootstrap estimates, not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

Historical holdout is not a prospective test. Repeated tuning after viewing it invalidates its role.

Top-20 uses each underlying unshrunk ranking, including methods whose Brier strength is zero; no method is selected on top-20 holdout performance.
